Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome checks {#checks}

Run and read the API change check suite (one verdict for a pull request).

```text
apiome checks [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`run`](#checks-run), [`show`](#checks-show).

## apiome checks run {#checks-run}

Evaluate the API change check suite for a version (POST …/check-suite).

Re-running over unchanged inputs returns the same evaluation — the same evidence ids — and does not report to the provider again. Exit codes: 0 pass or skipped, 7 failed, 8 pending, 1 unreachable, 2 rejected (auth, unknown project/version/commit).

```text
apiome checks run [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `--version` | text |  | yes | Version label or revision UUID. |
| `--commit` | text |  |  | Commit to report against (e.g. $GITHUB_SHA). Defaults to the commit the draft is synchronized with; only a version bound to a repository ref takes one. |
| `--pr` | integer range |  |  | Pull request number the commit belongs to. |
| `--publish` / `--no-publish` | flag | `--publish` |  | Report the verdict on the pull request (on by default). |
| `--format` | text | `text` |  | Output: text (default), json (the API response), or md (the pull-request summary). |

## apiome checks show {#checks-show}

Read an API change check suite evaluation without evaluating anything.

Exits with the evaluation's verdict, like ``checks run``. A stale evaluation (the draft or the policy moved since) is reported on stderr — run the suite again for a current answer.

```text
apiome checks show [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Version label or revision UUID (the latest evaluation of it). |
| `--run` | text |  |  | One evaluation by id — the drill-down a pull request links to. |
| `--commit` | text |  |  | Only the latest evaluation at this commit (with --version). |
| `--format` | text | `text` |  | Output: text (default), json (the API response), or md (the pull-request summary). |
